description: The five projects of the EasyMesh labs, grouped by goal, and the commit each was last pinned at (./pin); the images the labs run that are built outside a lab VM, and the commit each was built from. ./sync clones the projects into this workspace.
end_goal: One EasyMesh system on wmediumd: native EasyMesh agents and existing OpenSync pods, through the EMOSA adapter, together.

goals.adapter: The OpenSync adapter: existing OpenSync pods in an EasyMesh system
goals.physical: EasyMesh on physical hardware: certified extenders and real clients, the protocol learned on the wire
